raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

The DeepSeek V4.1 encoder rejects `tool_reference` content parts with a 400, and `/v1/messages` turns a `tool_result` with `tool_reference` items into two `tool` messages for one call. This renders each reference on V4.1 as the tool's name and emits one `tool` message per `tool_result`, so conversations that use Claude Code's tool search work on DeepSeek V4.1 and render one result per tool call.

## Claims

- Requests with `tool_reference` parts render on DeepSeek V4.1. On main they fail with `DeepSeek V4.1 supports text and image content only; got 'tool_reference'`. This covers `tool_result` blocks with `tool_reference` items on `/v1/messages`, and `tool_reference` parts on `/v1/chat/completions`.
- On V4.1, each reference renders as the tool's name inside its call's `<tool_result>`. Several references are joined with `\n\n`, the separator the encoder already uses between parts.
- `/v1/messages` emits one `tool` message per `tool_result`: the `tool_reference` parts first, then the text. On main, a tool search result renders an extra empty result before the references, on GLM-5.3 as well as V4.1, so after parallel tool calls the results no longer line up with the calls.
- Templates that expand references keep working: GLM-5.3 renders the referenced tool definitions as before.
- A `tool_result` without `tool_reference` items converts as before, and other unsupported part types still return 400 on V4.1.
- The change is in `_convert_user_tool_result` (`vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/serving.py`) and `_normalize_messages` (`vllm/tokenizers/deepseek_v41.py`): 15 lines added and 11 removed, plus three tests.

## Validation

| Check | Command | main `5d55ef1590` | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| New tests | `pytest tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py::TestToolResultContent::test_tool_result_with_tool_references tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_render.py::test_messages_render_tool_search_result_for_deepseek_v41 tests/tokenizers_/test_deepseek_v41.py::test_tool_references_render_as_tool_names` | 3 failed (below) | 3 passed |
| Changed test files | `pytest tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_render.py tests/tokenizers_/test_deepseek_v41.py tests/tokenizers_/test_deepseek_v4.py` | 271 passed, 4 failed (the 3 new tests and 1 below) | 274 passed, 1 failed (below) |
| `vllm launch render` with the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash config and tokenizer, 4 requests (below) | | 4 of 4 HTTP 400 | 4 of 4 HTTP 200, one `<tool_result>` per call |
| `vllm launch render` with the GLM-5.3 config, tokenizer and chat template, 3 requests (below) | | 3 of 3 HTTP 200, one extra `<tool_response>` each | 3 of 3 HTTP 200, one `<tool_response>` per call |

The conversion test sends a `tool_result` with text, two `tool_reference` items and an image, and checks for one `tool` message with the references first, followed by the image's `user` message. The render test starts `vllm launch render deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` through `RemoteLaunchRenderServer`, which downloads only the config and tokenizer, like the existing GPT-OSS render test. It sends a `/v1/messages` turn where a tool search and a file read ran in parallel, and checks the rendered user turn through `/detokenize`. On main the new tests fail like this:

```
E       AssertionError: assert ['assistant',...user', 'tool'] == ['assistant', 'tool', 'user']
E           AssertionError: {"error":{"message":"DeepSeek V4.1 supports text and image content only; got 'tool_reference'","type":"BadRequestError","param":null,"code":400}}
E                       ValueError: DeepSeek V4.1 supports text and image content only; got 'tool_reference'
3 failed, 3 warnings in 18.48s
```

With only the V4.1 encoder change and main's converter, the render test still fails: the parallel turn renders three `<tool_result>`s for two calls.

The one other failure in the changed files is `test_tokenize_matches_chat_render_for_gpt_oss`, which fails the same way on main here because the container cannot download the Harmony vocab file. Tests ran on CPU in `vllm-ci-postmerge-repo:074c83a09a0b872cec92e244d91adf2b3c55e41b-arm64-cpu` with the branch tree on `PYTHONPATH`. The repo's pre-commit hooks pass, including `ruff`, `mypy` and the test tethering check. No model evaluation is included: the change only affects prompts with `tool_reference` items.

<details>
<summary>Render server checks</summary>

**DeepSeek V4.1.** The server runs `vllm launch render deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 --enable-auto-tool-choice --language-model-only`, with `config.json` and the tokenizer from revision `314113f8` and no weights. Every request declares a `ToolSearch` tool, plus `get_weather` and `get_time` with `defer_loading: true`.

1. `/v1/messages/render`, shaped like a Claude Code tool search: the last user turn is a `tool_result` whose content is `[{"type": "tool_reference", "tool_name": "get_weather"}]`.
2. The same conversation one turn later, after `get_weather` was called and returned.
3. `/v1/chat/completions/render` with a `tool` message whose content is `[{"type": "tool_reference", "name": "get_weather"}]`.
4. `/v1/messages/render` where one assistant turn calls `ToolSearch` and `Read` in parallel, and the user turn returns the reference result and a text result.

On main all four return the 400 above. On this branch, requests 1 and 3 end with `<tool_result>get_weather</tool_result>` before the generation prompt, request 2 has one result for each of its two calls, request 4 ends with `<tool_result>get_weather</tool_result>\n\n<tool_result>NOTES-FILE-BODY</tool_result>`, and the system prompt of every request lists all tools.

**GLM-5.3.** The server runs `vllm launch render` with the GLM-5.3 `config.json` and tokenizer, the chat template from Hub revision `ba32f8c19c`, `--tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45 --enable-auto-tool-choice`, and requests 1 and 4 above plus a third `/v1/messages` request whose `tool_result` holds a text block and a `tool_reference`.

| Request | main | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Tool search | `<tool_response></tool_response><tool_response><tools>{get_weather}</tools></tool_response>` | `<tool_response><tools>{get_weather}</tools></tool_response>` |
| Parallel `ToolSearch` + `Read` | 3 `<tool_response>`s for 2 calls, the first one empty | `<tool_response><tools>{get_weather}</tools></tool_response><tool_response>NOTES-FILE-BODY</tool_response>` |
| Text and reference in one result | `<tool_response>Found 1 tool</tool_response><tool_response><tools>{get_weather}</tools></tool_response>` | `<tool_response><tools>{get_weather}</tools></tool_response>` |

`{get_weather}` stands for the tool's full JSON definition, which both arms render identically.

</details>

## Details

**Root cause.** #40190 added `tool_reference` parts. `_convert_user_tool_result` emits a `tool` message with the result's text (empty for a plain tool search), then a second `tool` message with the `tool_reference` items, both for the same `tool_use_id`. An image in the result goes into a `user` message between the two. Templates and encoders that render one result per `tool` message render one result too many. Separately, V4.1 renders with its own encoder, and `_normalize_messages` raises `ValueError` for any part type other than text and image. The `tool_result` stays in the conversation history, so on V4.1 every later request in that conversation fails too, and an agent session that runs a tool search cannot continue.

**Why one message, references first.** Templates that expand references look for a `tool` message whose first part is a `tool_reference` (GLM-5.3's does), so the references lead and the text follows. Images stay in the `user` message after the `tool` message. Limitation: GLM-5.3's template expands such a message and skips its other parts, so text that sits beside references in one `tool_result` no longer renders there; on main it rendered as an extra result. The tool search docs show results that hold only `tool_reference` blocks.

**Why the name.** `apply_chat_template` puts every request tool into the V4.1 system prompt, deferred ones included, so the definitions a reference points at are already in context. The name tells the model which tools the search returned. The Cohere renderer renders these parts the same way (`vllm/renderers/cohere.py`). The model's Jinja template on the Hub drops unknown block types, which would render the search result empty.

**Related.** #52498 and #52610 (open, for #52489) rewrite `tool_reference` items as text in the Anthropic converter for every model. That would also stop the V4.1 400 on `/v1/messages`, but `/v1/chat/completions` requests with these parts would still fail, and the structured parts that templates expanding references rely on would be gone.

**AI assistance.** Claude Code was used for the root-cause analysis, the fix, the tests and this description.

</details>

nodes.body: Agreed, the split in `_convert_user_tool_result` was the root cause, and both misses were real. Pushed 3b32554a5e: one `tool` message per `tool_result`, `tool_reference` parts first, then text, and the V4.1 merge pass is gone. With `vllm launch render`, GLM-5.3 on main renders an extra empty `<tool_response>` (three for two parallel calls), and the branch renders one per call with the expansion intact. One tradeoff: GLM-5.3's template expands a references-first message and skips its other parts, so text next to references no longer renders there. The tool search docs show references-only results, so I think that can be a template follow-up.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks for digging into this! I think the root cause is a bit upstream though. The Anthropic converter (`_convert_user_tool_result`) turns one tool_result with tool_reference parts into two tool messages: an empty one, then one with the references. So every renderer that pairs results with calls by position sees one extra result, not just V4.1.

I checked with `vllm launch render`. DeepSeek V4 and GLM-5.1 (the template tool_reference support was first built for) both render an extra empty result for a plain tool search result on main. The V4.1 merge also misses two cases: a result with an image (the image's user message sits between the two tool messages) and a result with no tool_use_id.

What do you think about fixing it in the converter instead? It would emit a single tool message per tool_result, with the tool_reference parts first and then any text. Then the merge pass in the V4.1 encoder isn't needed, and you keep your tool_reference-to-name rendering.

issue_comments.body: Agreed, the split in `_convert_user_tool_result` was the root cause, and both misses were real. Pushed 3b32554a5e: one `tool` message per `tool_result`, `tool_reference` parts first, then text, and the V4.1 merge pass is gone. With `vllm launch render`, GLM-5.3 on main renders an extra empty `<tool_response>` (three for two parallel calls), and the branch renders one per call with the expansion intact. One tradeoff: GLM-5.3's template expands a references-first message and skips its other parts, so text next to references no longer renders there. The tool search docs show references-only results, so I think that can be a template follow-up.

reviews.body:
## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks for digging into this! I think the root cause is a bit upstream though. The Anthropic converter (`_convert_user_tool_result`) turns one tool_result with tool_reference parts into two tool messages: an empty one, then one with the references. So every renderer that pairs results with calls by position sees one extra result, not just V4.1.

I checked with `vllm launch render`. DeepSeek V4 and GLM-5.1 (the template tool_reference support was first built for) both render an extra empty result for a plain tool search result on main. The V4.1 merge also misses two cases: a result with an image (the image's user message sits between the two tool messages) and a result with no tool_use_id.

What do you think about fixing it in the converter instead? It would emit a single tool message per tool_result, with the tool_reference parts first and then any text. Then the merge pass in the V4.1 encoder isn't needed, and you keep your tool_reference-to-name rendering.
